name: Camping 101: Leatherworking

angles.text: As a rogue, you rely on rest and shelter in the wilds to stay sharp. A leather tent can help you find both.
To make a proper camp, you need a warm campfire. Cooking trainers across the land teach you how to make one.

faq.answer: Nadyia Maneweaver teaches the camping skill along the road from Dolanaar toward Darnassus on Teldrassil.

aliases: what do i learn from camping 101
faq.answer: Leatherworkers learn to make a tent that keeps travelers cool in hot weather and dry in the rain.
faq.q: What do leatherworkers learn from this quest?

aliases: where can i pitch my tent
can i pitch a tent in town
faq.answer: Pitch tents in the open wilderness, outside settlements and city centers.
faq.q: Where can you pitch a camp tent?

aliases: what do i need for a campsite
do i need a campfire for tent
faq.answer: A camp needs a lit campfire as well as a tent. Cooking trainers teach the craft of making one.
faq.q: What else is required to set up a camp?

faq.answer: A tent shelters travelers from the weather and gives them rest, helping them stay alert far from inns.
faq.q: Why is having a tent useful for travelers?

faq.answer: Nadyia Maneweaver is along the main road from Dolanaar toward Darnassus, the night elf capital.

sections.body: Across Kalimdor, an open sky can bring hard weather. Skilled leatherworkers learn to shape hides and pelts into sturdy shelters, giving travelers a safe place to rest wherever the road leads. A tent lets wanderers find the rest they need far from the inns.
sections.title: Shelter in the Wilderness

sections.body: Nadyia Maneweaver teaches proficient leatherworkers along the forest road between Dolanaar and Darnassus. She shows them how to stitch a sturdy tent for the trail. A tent needs a campfire to make a proper camp, and cooks teach that craft. Set the shelter in the open wilds, away from town streets.
sections.title: The Road from Dolanaar

summary: On Teldrassil, leatherworkers can learn to make a shelter for the trail. Find Nadyia Maneweaver on the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus, where she teaches the craft of tents that keep travelers dry and cool.
